changelog:
- Initial release of the "trump-trade" skill for educational and research use.
- Tracks and analyzes Trump's public TRUTH posts from trumpstruth.org/feed.
- Supports multiple modes: Evidence, Latest, Time, Trump-style opinion, chart/candle sketch requests, and incremental watch/monitoring.
- Provides mapped financial analysis for various markets and themes (oil, USD, gold, stocks, etc.) using post evidence or Trump-style commentary.
- Enforces strict compliance: no trade advice, no guaranteed outcomes, and requires evidence for post-related claims.
- Outputs structured summaries, risk warnings, and scenario sketches in all relevant modes.
summary: English version of the Trump RSS analysis skill. Uses trumpstruth.org/feed to track Trump's public TRUTH posts, support Evidence / Latest / Time / Watch mode...
